card.name: Tumba Francesa
card.profile: Tumba francesa ('French drum') is an Afro-Haitian-Cuban genre of dance, song and drumming brought to eastern Cuba (Oriente) by French colonists and their enslaved Haitians fleeing the Haitian Revolution. It fuses the kinetic vocabulary of French court ballroom dances with African drumming. Two main dance styles survive: the mason (a light parody of French ballroom dance) and the yuba (improvised, to rousing drum rhythms). Instruments include the cata idiophone, three single-headed tumbas, the tamborita and the chacha/maruga, with a compose leading call-and-response with female tumberas (English Wikipedia; UNESCO).
card.insight: Inscribed on the UNESCO Representative List in 2008 (file 00052), having originally been proclaimed a Masterpiece of the Oral and Intangible Heritage of Humanity in 2003 (UNESCO).
